topic: How a Sanad office cut its client status-update calls by 80% in one month — exactly what changed
format: Open with a question that forces the reader to calculate their own answer: how many work permits are you tracking right now, and where exactly is that information?
post:
How many work permits are you tracking right now — and where, exactly, is that information?

If your answer involves scrolling up a WhatsApp thread or opening a shared Excel file that three people have edited this week, you already know the problem.

One Sanad office manager I spoke with was handling 40 work permits, 15 visa renewals, and 8 MOL filings across 20 client companies. Status calls were eating 2-3 hours of her day. Not because clients were difficult. Because they had no other way to know what was happening.

She switched to SmartPRO Hub in month one.

Every client got a portal. Every case had a status. Every expiry triggered an automatic alert before anyone had to chase.

Status-update calls dropped 80% in 30 days.

Not because she worked more. Because the information was finally visible — to her and to the client at the same time.

Work permit tracking in Oman doesn't have to live in someone's head or a WhatsApp group. It can live in a system that updates itself.

The offices that figure this out first will be the ones clients stop leaving.

What's your biggest time drain right now — chasing updates, or preventing them from being needed?
